about: Every image/video of JA2 Gold with its proposed method. Names only: no art is stored here. Built by tools/assets/manifest.py; edit the rules in tools/assets/ja2assets/classify.py.

methods.design-new: Designed new from the design system (vector/procedural UI chrome, icons, cursors, markers)
methods.regenerate: Rendered from game data at HD (radar maps, strategic map)
methods.upscale: Pixel-art-aware upscale + cleanup (faces, items, world tiles, animations, load screens, video)
methods.repaint: Hand repaint / new art for the most-seen content (big merc portraits)

status: Every asset is 'todo' unless it has a "status" of its own (in-progress, review, done).

categoryNotes.animation: palette-swap body parts via recolour masks; frame stability gate
categoryNotes.content-in-ui: content art inside the UI archive
categoryNotes.editor: map editor art (editor: keep legacy or rebuild, Phase 7)
categoryNotes.radar-map: overhead map rendered from the sector
